tasks.dev: deno task build && deno run --allow-net --allow-read jsr:@std/http@1/file-server --port 8131 dist
tasks.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp web/index.html web/favicon.png web/icon-512.png web/apple-touch-icon.png web/og.png data/cmudict.dict dist/ && deno bundle --platform browser --minify -o dist/app.js web/app.ts
tasks.check: deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno check
